jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
Overview
Responsible for leading business and technology initiatives within Equipment Finance, including the evaluation, modernization, implementation, and optimization of technology capabilities supporting origination, underwriting, servicing, asset management, customer experience, and operational workflows. Partners closely with business leaders, technology teams, architects, vendors, and transformation resources to define future-state capabilities, develop implementation roadmaps, and deliver business value through technology modernization.
The ideal candidate will possess deep equipment finance expertise, experience with servicing and lease management platforms, and a proven track record supporting large-scale technology transformation and leading implementation initiatives.
- This position can also be located out of our Buffalo, Rochester or Rockville Corporate Office Locations

Primary Responsibilities
Product & Platform Strategy
- Define and maintain the vision, strategy, and roadmap for equipment finance platform enablement initiatives.
- Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, scalability, risk management, and profitability through technology modernization.
- Translate business objectives into platform capabilities, epics, features, and implementation priorities.
- Evaluate current-state processes, systems, data flows, and operational pain points to identify modernization opportunities.

Transformation & Implementation
- Lead end-to-end technology transformation initiatives involving equipment finance servicing, origination, document management, workflow automation, customer portals, reporting, and integrations.
- Collaborate with technology teams, enterprise architects, and implementation partners to define future-state solutions and deployment roadmaps.
- Support platform assessments, vendor evaluations, proofs of concept, and business case development.
- Ensure successful delivery of system upgrades, platform consolidations, migrations, and modernization programs.
- Coordinate business readiness, testing, operational transition, and post-implementation adoption activities.

Equipment Finance Domain Leadership
- Serve as a subject matter expert for equipment finance business processes, including: - Origination
- Credit and underwriting
- Documentation and funding
- Servicing
- Billing and collections
- Asset and collateral management
- End-of-term processing

- Partner with operations and servicing teams to ensure platform decisions align with business needs and future operating models.
- Drive continuous improvement across the equipment finance customer and employee experience.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Build strong partnerships across business, technology, operations, risk, finance, and external vendors.
- Facilitate workshops, requirements gathering sessions, and future-state design discussions.
- Challenge assumptions and drive data-driven decision making regarding platform investments and priorities.
- Manage relationships with platform providers, implementation partners, and consulting organizations.

Data, Reporting & Governance
- Define KPIs and success measures for platform modernization initiatives.
- Monitor benefits realization, adoption metrics, operational outcomes, and customer experience improvements.
- Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, data strategy, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards.
- Support governance forums, steering committees, and executive-level reporting.

Risk & Controls
- Understand and adhere to the Company's risk and regulatory standards, policies, and controls in accordance with the Company's Risk Appetite.
- Identify and escalate transformation, technology, operational, and vendor-related risks.
- Maintain M&T internal control standards and support audit and regulatory remediation activities as needed.

Education & Experience Required
Required
- Bachelor's degree.
- 5+ years of experience in Equipment Finance, Leasing, Commercial Banking, Product Management, Operations, Technology, Program Management, or related disciplines.
- Demonstrated experience leading technology implementation, modernization, or transformation initiatives.
- Deep understanding of equipment finance servicing and lease management processes.
- Experience working with servicing and lease management systems such as: - InfoLease
- Alfa
- LTi
- Odessa
- Similar equipment finance servicing platforms

- Experience partnering with business and technology teams to define requirements and deliver complex solutions.
- Strong skills in stakeholder management, requirements development, roadmap planning, and executive communication.

Preferred
- Direct experience supporting or implementing InfoLease upgrades, migrations, or integrations.
- Experience with equipment finance origination, servicing, collateral management, and customer portal solutions.
- Experience with system integration, workflow automation, document management, CRM, and data/reporting platforms.
- Familiarity with Agile product management methodologies and tools.
- Experience working with third-party software vendors, system integrators, or consulting partners.

#LI-LA1

jobs.title: Product Manager V
jobs.description:
Overview:
Provides strategic direction for lending products existing or new market segment(s) of a larger and/or more complex nature.  Manages product design and development of market strategies (i.e. advertising, pricing, expense planning, profit plans, packaging, future products etc.) and goals to support successful implementation; monitors achievement of the goals.  Manages the development and implementation of supporting policy and procedures.   May have profit/loss responsibility for the product.

Primary Responsibilities:
- Set strategic direction for lending products existing and new market segment(s) of a larger and/or more complex nature, and present supporting business plans to senior management and employees.
- Responsible for product pricing guidance, understanding and recommending improvements to cost structure and helping to manage product risk for products and/or services managed.  Responsible for all supporting product financials including revenue planning and product profitability.
- Maintain a current awareness of new competitive developments in company markets, and in response evaluate and recommend new services, new products or geographies, or modify existing services or products.  Evaluate new product/services success to make adjustments as required; implement and manage changes in service or marketing strategy as required.
- Manage aspects of new product implementation and existing product modification for assigned products and/or services, including, but not limited to, design and development of services, portfolio acquisition and process improvements; serve in a liaison capacity with other areas of the Company to ensure the requisite support for products and/or services managed.
- Work with other Bank departments to develop effective programs to sell these products and/or services.
- Ensure product/services are marketable, profitable and comply with legal and regulatory requirements, while minimizing risk to the Bank.
- Maintain an awareness of new trends and developments in marketing and Company products and services to ensure alignment.
- Adhere to applicable compliance/operational risk controls in accordance with Company or regulatory standards and policies.
- Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
- Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
- Complete other related duties as assigned.
- Exercise usual authority of a manager concerning staffing, performance appraisals, promotions, salary recommendations, performance management and terminations.

Scope of Responsibilities:
As a senior level Product Manager the position’s results and/or actions impact the Bank’s long-term operations, revenues or profitability.  As a result, the position has extensive contact with other Bank departments for the effective and profitable marketing of new products and the enhancement of existing products for which the position is responsible.
The position champions strategies and development of new and improved processes that support business growth, organizational efficiencies and customer service objectives through assigned products and/or services.
In addition, the position oversees and evaluates high-level processing key performance indicator models and develops reporting to manage business function processes effectively.

Supervisory/ Managerial Responsibilities:
Manages a team of professionals (includes people, budget and planning).

Education and Experience Required:
Bachelor’s degree, and a minimum of 12 years’ experience in Marketing, Bank Operations, Credit Analysis and/or relevant product line(s), or in lieu of a degree a combined minimum of 16 years’ higher education and/or work experience, including a minimum of 12 years’ experience in Marketing, Bank Operations, Credit Analysis and/or relevant product line(s).
7 years’managerial and/or project management experience in relevant product line(s).
Strong financial analysis skills, including cash flow and components of product profitability.
Excellent developmental, analytical and research skills.
Extensive network of industry and client contacts on a national scale and extensive market intelligence.
Industry-specific knowledge.
Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong presentation skills.
Demonstrated principled leadership skills with sound business ethics.
Dedicated customer service focus. Ability to use expert resources when necessary.

Education and Experience Preferred:
Master’s degree.
Extensive knowledge of Bank/personal computer software programs utilized by the Division.
Ability to interact professionally with all levels of personnel, including senior management.
Self-motivated, well-organized individual.
Action-oriented individual.
Ability to work under critical time constraints.

jobs.title: Senior Escrow Product Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:
M&T Bank is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Escrow & Virtual Account Management (VAM) Product Manager to lead the growth, modernization, and commercialization of our escrow and virtual account solutions. This role is responsible for defining product strategy, delivering new capabilities, managing the product roadmap, and ensuring that M&T's escrow and VAM offerings meet the evolving needs of commercial clients across multiple industry segments.

The successful candidate will combine deep product management expertise with strong commercial banking knowledge to deliver differentiated solutions for clients requiring fund segregation, reconciliation, liquidity optimization, and operational efficiency.

This position serves as the central point of accountability across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Legal, Treasury Management, and Sales teams to successfully design, launch, and enhance escrow and virtual account solutions.

Primary Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Market Leadership:
- Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for Escrow and Virtual Account Management solutions.
- Identify emerging client needs, industry trends, competitive threats, and fintech opportunities.
- Define product positioning and value propositions across Commercial Banking, Business Banking, and specialized vertical markets.
- Establish multi-year product vision aligned with M&T's deposits, liquidity, and treasury management strategies.

New Capability Development:
- Build business cases, secure funding, establish success metrics, and manage prioritization.
- Partner with Technology and Agile delivery teams to execute product initiatives.
- Drive capabilities such as: - Self-service virtual account administration
- Virtual account-to-physical account reconciliation
- Enhanced reporting and analytics
- Treasury workstation and ERP integrations
- API connectivity
- Automated funding and sweeps
- Real-time payments and liquidity functionality

- These initiatives align with existing roadmap priorities including reconciliation tools, Treasury Center integration, balance reporting, Direct Connect integration, and enhanced escrow reporting.

​ Market Segmentation & Client Differentiation:
- Design product strategies tailored to the unique needs of distinct customer segments, including:

- Commercial Real Estate
- Property Management
- Attorney Trust Accounts
- Municipal Escrow
- 1031 Exchange Intermediaries
- Funeral Escrow Providers
- Leasing & Security Deposit Providers
- Large Corporate Treasury Organizations
- Franchise and Multi-Entity Businesses
- The Product Manager will be responsible for understanding the operational workflows, regulatory requirements, reconciliation challenges, and reporting needs unique to each segment and ensuring solutions are designed accordingly. M&T's escrow offering currently supports multiple specialized escrow structures across these client types.

Virtual Account Management Solution Design:

Lead the evolution of M&T's Virtual Account Management platform.
Responsibilities include:
- Designing virtual account hierarchies and account structures.
- Defining cash concentration and fund segregation models.
- Supporting treasury visibility and liquidity optimization.
- Developing reporting and reconciliation frameworks.
- Building client-controlled virtual account administration capabilities.
- Enhancing integration with Treasury Center, APIs, ERP platforms, and treasury workstations.
- Supporting real-time information delivery and account governance.

Commercialization & Revenue Growth:
- Partner with Treasury Management, Sales, Segment Management, and Marketing teams to drive product adoption.
- Develop pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies.
- Create sales enablement materials and client-facing value propositions.
- Support large prospect opportunities and strategic client engagements.

Risk, Compliance & Operational Excellence:
- Ensure products operate within all regulatory, legal, and risk management requirements.
- Partner with Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Audit functions.
- Drive operational efficiency and scalability.
- Identify process improvement opportunities that enhance both client and employee experiences.

Success Measures:

The Escrow & VAM Product Manager will be accountable for:
- Growing escrow and VAM revenue
- Increasing product adoption and client penetration
- Delivering new roadmap capabilities on schedule
- Improving client satisfaction and retention
- Reducing operational complexity and servicing costs
- Enhancing competitive differentiation in target markets
- Improving treasury visibility and reconciliation outcomes for clients

Education and Experience Required:
- Bachelor’s degree
- 7 years’ proven product management experience in commercial banking, treasury management, liquidity solutions, or payments.
- OR in lieu of a degree,
- A combined minimum of 11 years’ higher education and/or work experience, including a minimum of 7 years
- Proven product management experience in commercial banking, treasury management, liquidity solutions, or payments.

Education and Experience Preferred:
- Experience with: - Escrow services
- Virtual Account Management
- ZBA and Sweep solutions
- Treasury Management platforms
- ERP integrations
- Commercial deposit products

- Knowledge of commercial real estate, property management, legal trust, and fund administration workflows
- Proven experience launching and commercializing new banking or fintech capabilities.
- Experience managing cross-functional product delivery initiatives.
- Strong understanding of commercial deposit and liquidity products.
- Demonstrated ability to create product roadmaps and business cases.
- Experience working with Technology, Operations, Risk, and Sales organizations.

jobs.title: Appian Forward Deployed Product Owner (Bond Management)
jobs.description:
Overview:
The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic digital transformation program. The goals of the program are to grow revenue through new and transformed digital-first trust and agency service products, to move from a product-centric to client-centric operating model, to move from market-specific to global solutions, and to dramatically lower the cost to serve.

Wilmington Trust is seeking an Appian Forward Deployed Product Owner to accelerate the modernization of Bond Management capabilities and the operational workflows supporting Corporate Trust products and services. This role is designed for an experienced product, business analysis, or transformation professional who can operate close to business users, translate operational needs into deployable digital workflows, and help lead iterative delivery in a regulated financial services environment.

This role combines Product Ownership, business process transformation, and hands-on Appian workflow design responsibilities within a regulated financial services environment. The role requires hands-on Appian experience, strong business process and analytical skills, and the ability to partner across business, operations, technology, risk, and product stakeholders to move quickly from discovery to working solutions.

Ideal candidates will be comfortable owning product outcomes, facilitating working sessions, writing stories and specifications, validating build quality, and using AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, prototyping, testing, and workflow improvement.

Primary Responsibilities:
- Design, configure, and improve business process workflows using Appian Designer, with a focus on speed to value, user-centric design, reuse, governance, and operational control.
- Lead business process discovery across Bond Management operations, including debt servicing, transfer agent, paying agent, waterfall accounting, and exception management processes.
- Identify automation opportunities, document current state pain points, and establish baseline measures for effort, cycle time, exception volume, straight-through processing, and control effectiveness.
- Define value hypotheses, business outcomes, and success measures to guide workflow prioritization, backlog decisions, and benefit realization.
- Apply Appian to modernize Bond Management workflows across debt servicing, transfer agent, paying agent, waterfall accounting, exception management, and related operational control processes.
- Partner closely with business product owners, operations leaders, technology teams, and risk partners to gather requirements, map processes, define user needs, and prioritize workflow improvements.
- Own and manage product backlog items, including authoring, refining, and grooming user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, process flows, UI concepts, test scenarios, and release-ready requirements.
- Lead stakeholder working sessions to define current-state and future-state workflows, identify friction points, iterate on MVP designs, resolve issues, and drive alignment across business and technology teams.
- Build, configure, and maintain workflows in Appian Designer, leveraging out-of-the-box components wherever possible to accelerate delivery, support consistency, and reduce the need for custom development.
- Use AI-assisted and agentic AI tools to accelerate discovery, process analysis, requirements documentation, story drafting, workflow prototyping, test case generation, defect analysis, and delivery communications.
- Own assigned Bond Management workflow outcomes from discovery through configuration, validation, pilot adoption, and post release optimization; establish baselines and measure realized improvements in straight-through processing, exception volume, cycle time, manual effort, control effectiveness, and user adoption.
- Support QA, UAT, regression testing, and production validation by defining test scenarios, validating builds, documenting defects, gathering issue resolution requirements, and confirming readiness for release.
- Partner with technology teams on integration points, data dependencies, security considerations, platform constraints, and production support needs.
- ·         Keep current with Appian capabilities, including Appian AI, Case Management Studio, RPA, data fabric, reporting, and platform governance, and recommend opportunities to apply new capabilities responsibly.
- Champion Appian best practices around governance, reusability, modular design, versioning, packaging, maintainability, and controlled delivery in a regulated environment.
- Participate in agile ceremonies, including daily standups, planning sessions, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives.
- Build and maintain Appian reports and dashboards to track workflow performance, user activity, operational quality, and business metrics; partner with senior stakeholders to define meaningful KPIs.
- Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
- Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
- Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
- Complete other related duties as assigned.

Education and Experience Required:
- Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 10 years’ business, analytical, technical, digital product, transformation, or product ownership experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 14 years’ higher education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 10 years’ business, analytical, technical, digital product, transformation, or product ownership experience.
- Hands-on experience with Appian, including experience building, configuring, testing, or supporting workflows, forms, interfaces, records, process models, reports, dashboards, or related Appian objects.
- Experience in financial services and/or fintech, including exposure to regulated business processes, operational risk, client service, banking, wealth management, trust services, payments, capital markets, lending, compliance, or similar domains.
- Experience operating as a product owner, product analyst, business analyst, transformation lead, or workflow designer in an agile or iterative delivery environment.
- Experience writing detailed, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, process flows, business rules, UI concepts, testing scenarios, or release documentation.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous problems, assess operational impacts, analyze data or process evidence, and recommend practical solutions.
- Exposure to QA, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, test case development, production validation, or other solution quality practices.
- Working knowledge of AI-assisted tools or agentic AI concepts and the ability to use AI responsibly to improve analysis, documentation, testing, prototyping, or workflow delivery.
- Ability to bridge business and technical teams, translating needs into executable solutions and explaining technical constraints, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to stakeholders.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to facilitate working sessions, present recommendations, document decisions, and drive alignment across teams.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and deliver in a fast-paced, regulated transformation environment.

Education and Experience Preferred:

Overview:
The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic digital transformation program. The goals of the program are to grow revenue through new and transformed digital-first trust and agency service products, to move from a product-centric to client-centric operating model, to move from market-specific to global solutions, and to dramatically lower the cost to serve.

Wilmington Trust is seeking an Appian Forward Deployed Product Owner to help accelerate digital transformation across our core operations. This role is designed for an experienced product, business analysis, or transformation professional who can operate close to business users, translate operational needs into deployable digital workflows, and help lead iterative delivery in a regulated financial services environment.
This role is a hybrid between a product owner, business analyst, low-code workflow designer, and AI-enabled process lead, with a strong focus on designing and configuring end-to-end workflows directly in Appian Designer.

The role requires hands-on Appian experience , strong business process and analytical skills, and the ability to partner across business, operations, technology, risk, and product stakeholders to move quickly from discovery to working solutions.  While working closely with individual business teams, the role will maintain a platform-first mindset by leveraging shared capabilities, reusable components, and consistent design patterns rather than creating isolated or duplicative solutions.

Ideal candidates will be comfortable owning product outcomes, facilitating working sessions, writing stories and specifications, validating build quality, and using AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, prototyping, testing, and workflow improvement.
